subject: Patch Me If You Can
body_text:
Good morning! Here's the latest in trending: Trade war: Canada's Carney unveils billions of dollars in government financial support. Earnings: Meta (META) rises on stock split and Muse promise, but faces a serious bill in New Mexico. New generation: As cost pressures weigh on General Motors (GM), it looks toward autonomous vehicles.

 Good morning! Here's the latest in trending : 

 Trade war: Canada's Carney unveils billions of dollars in government financial support . 

 Earnings: Meta ( META ) rises on stock split and Muse promise , but faces a serious bill in New Mexico . 

 New generation: As cost pressures weigh on General Motors ( GM ), it looks toward autonomous vehicles .
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Top News
 
 
 
 Code red 
 
 
 
Getty Images
 
 
 The world is entering another new era due to the advance of AI, which some are referring to as Bugmageddon. An alarming PHP security flaw just triggered a massive global cybersecurity emergency, with the vulnerability impacting up to 70% of all websites on the internet, including platforms powered by WordPress, Drupal, and Joomla. The exploit had been hiding in the code for more than a decade, but was uncovered using frontier AI models, prompting  government sites and online services to be taken offline .

Quote: "In the 10 hours before it was publicly announced, across the Cloudflare network we saw thousands of attempts to exploit it," Cloudflare ( NET ) CEO Matthew Prince declared on X. "That jumped to tens of thousands in the 45 minutes post announcement, hundreds of thousands within 2 hours, and millions now." Prior to the public disclosure, the company deployed protections to block suspicious traffic, as well as putting safeguards into place for all customers, including free-plan users.

While using artificial intelligence to flesh out security vulnerabilities is nothing new, the scale at which it could do it is only growing. The new flaws, collectively known as "PHP2Shell," were considered among the most far-reaching bugs in internet history because they allowed hackers to take complete control of web servers without requiring a password or user credentials. "The Administration is tracking and coordinating with federal agencies and leading [AI] labs to expedite the release of the fix and protect American networks and critical infrastructure," according to a White House statement.

 Race against time: The good news is that the vulnerability was found by researchers at cyber firms Calif and Wiz, which was recently bought by Alphabet ( GOOGL ) for $32B . Developers then worked with PHP, OpenAI, and WordPress to patch things up before going public; however, it leaked on social media a day before the planned disclosure. Just like these flaws could be found with AI, they might also be exploited by AI. Attackers, along with defenders, have access to AI tools that can reverse engineer these updates and can work quickly to turn them into exploits before proper patches are deployed. This has fueled concerns about the coming era of automated cyber warfare, where zero-day vulnerabilities are weaponized at unprecedented scale before defender networks can patch them.
